title: HP Victus 15 Thanksgiving campaign
scenario: It is Thanksgiving week 2026 and you are shopping for a gaming laptop. {n} different offers for the same HP laptop reach you by email and social feed. You know HP as a brand. Judge them on how they speak to YOU.

persona_fields.budget_context: how much they can spend on a laptop this season and what they own now
persona_fields.knowledge_context: how much they know about gaming laptop specs and where they research purchases

scale: interest scale: 1=none, 2=slight, 3=moderate (would read more), 4=strong (would seriously consider buying), 5=would buy this week. Use the range and differentiate between the ads. If truly none appeal, click="none".
